name: Bangla Calendar Display
author: iamovk

sections.description: Bangla Calendar Display is a simple plugin that shows the current Bengali date and time on your WordPress site. It can be used in posts or pages using the [msabcd_bangla_calendar] shortcode. The plugin calculates the Bangla date based on the Gregorian calendar and handles leap years.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the bangla-calendar-display folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Use the [msabcd_bangla_calendar] shortcode in any post or page to display the Bangla calendar.
sections.faq:
How do I use the Bangla Calendar?

Simply add the shortcode [msabcd_bangla_calendar] to any post or page where you want to display the Bangla date.
